summaryJa: 任務概要: 対象は作戦『INHERENT RESOLVE』の空中ISR任務。機体（識別情報は編集済）がOJMSを2008/10/20 0823Z発、SLR経由で出発し、翌日210124Zに基地へ帰還、最終着陸は210447Z。総任務時間20時間24分、FMV運用14時間22分、SIGINT運用13時間02分。FMVタスキング3件、SIGINTタスキング3件。主要機器にAN/DAS-4およびSANTA FE、データリンクはLINK 16。FMVはGETにより解析。  ISR活動: 1102Z（座標37S FV 85）到着時に3名のADMSと1台のオートバイを観測、1102–1200Zはポイント監視で特段の変化なし。1230Z（37S FU 36）到着時に車両1台を観測。1230–1313Zは“eyes free”待機、1313–1410Zに対し1台のADM搭載オートバイに対して3回の停止追尾（stop follow）を実施。1447–1518Zに伝統服装のオートバイ上のADMに対して3回の停止追尾を実施。2252Zに再タスク。EEIは2回目のオンステーションで1件観測。  UAP観測: 初期接触201559Z。FMVカメラ映像上に由来不明の光・まばゆさ（light/glare）がフラッシュしたのを観測（発生期間記載は1559–1644Z）。観測に対するUAPの反応なし。観測機の高度20,088 ft、対気速度144 kt、飛行形態はオービット。UAPは書類上「プラズマ」と記載、推進手段不明、知的制御下ではないと評価（資料記載のまま）。
summaryEn: Mission summary: Air ISR for Operation INHERENT RESOLVE. The aircraft (identifying information redacted) departed OJMS via SLR at 0823Z on 20 Oct and returned to base at 0124Z, with final landing at 0447Z. Total mission time 20:24, FMV hours 14:22, SIGINT hours 13:02. Three FMV taskings and three SIGINT taskings were prosecuted. Key equipment listed: AN/DAS-4, SANTA FE sensor, LINK 16. FMV was exploited by GET.  ISR activity: On-station at 1102Z (37S FV 85) observed 3 ADMs and one motorcycle; conducted point observation 1102–1200Z with no significant changes. On-station at 1230Z (37S FU 36) observed one vehicle; 1230–1313Z was eyes-free awaiting SI, 1313–1410Z conducted three stop-follow actions on one ADM-mounted motorcycle. Between 1447–1518Z conducted three stop-follow actions on one ADM in traditional dress on a motorcycle. Retasked at 2252Z. One EEI was recorded during the second on-station period.  UAP observation: Initial contact 201559Z. FMV camera recorded an unexplained light/glare flash across the feed (noted 1559–1644Z). No change in the UAP in response to observer actions. Friendly aircraft reported at 20,088 ft, 144 kt, orbit. The report lists the UAP physical state as “plasma,” propulsion unknown, and not under intelligent control (as recorded in the source).
